description: Uploads a selected image for header/source-clue inspection. Returns editable source observations and limitations, not authenticated origin or exact model attribution. This adapter does not run the website's pixel-model fallback.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative local file path to an image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP)

image_url.description: Direct public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the image to analyze

name: detect_ai_image
